title: Pilot vouches for Marzulli's source using details he held back

tellings.quote: he purposely withheld certain details from the story so that if somebody comes forward trying to add additional information, he could vet whether or not they're telling the truth and he said that guy is telling the truth.

plain: A pilot who had a story to tell is said to have kept certain details secret on purpose, so he could test anyone who later came forward with more, and when a source of L.A. Marzulli, an author who writes about giants and the supernatural, came forward, the pilot said that man was telling the truth. Tim Alberino, a filmmaker who investigates claims of giants, relays this as it was told to him, naming Marzulli and the author Steve Quayle. It would mean the source's account was confirmed by someone who knew facts no one else had.
